Feature: Publish Folder Bookmark · Task B0 · Source: docs/brainstorming/02-publish-folder-bookmark.md

Objective

Emit the folder-publish migration SQL. Do NOT run it — human applies to CockroachDB (B0-apply gate).

Files

  • docs/plan/migrations/002_folder_bookmark_publish.sql (create)

Implementation

ALTER TABLE folder_bookmark add description STRING, location JSONB, location_name STRING, category_id INT8 (FK categories), published_at TIMESTAMPTZ. Create views_published_folders (joins folder_bookmark+users+categories+bookmark counts, filters is_published=true, users.banned=false, excludes delete-requested users). Full DDL in 02-publish-folder-bookmark.md Task B0.

Dependencies

None. Blocks B1–B5 live testing.

Feature: Publish Folder Bookmark · Task B1 · Source: docs/brainstorming/02-publish-folder-bookmark.md

Objective

PublishFolderBookmark — publish an owned folder with metadata; sets is_published=true. Non-empty gate (D7).

Files

  • src/Api/handlers/Bookmarks/PublishFolder.go (create, extends existing Bookmarks package)

Implementation

Body: sid (slug or id, ?sl=), name (req, max 255), description (max 2000), location JSON, category_id (req).

  1. Validate; role gate user. 2. Load folder_bookmark WHERE (id|slug)=sid AND user_id=userId → 409 if none (ownership). 3. D7: COUNT(bookmark WHERE folder_id=?); if 0 → 400. 4. Verify category_id in categories. 5. Derive location_name from location.name; escape name/description. 6. Transaction UPDATE folder_bookmark SET is_published=true, name, description, location, location_name, category_id, published_at=NOW(). 7. Redis.ListBookmarksUser. 8. ElasticBookmark.AddCounterTotalBookmarksV1. 9. Honor ?ec= like CreateFolderBookmarks.

Dependencies

B0 applied.

Testing Scenarios (docs/testing_scenarios/02-publish-folder-bookmark-tests.md §1)

Happy: PB-01 publish F1→200; PB-02 appears in place-detail; PB-03 in views_published_folders; PB-04 ?sl=true id lookup; PB-05 ?ec=true encrypted shape. Gates/validation: PB-10 empty folder F2→400 (D7); PB-11 missing name→400; PB-12 missing category→400; PB-13 bad category→400; PB-14 max length→400; PB-15 <b> escaped; PB-16 re-publish→200 idempotent. IDOR: PB-20 U2 publishes F1→409; PB-21 viewer→401.

Acceptance

  • publish sets flag+metadata; empty-folder→400; non-owner→409; appears in views; ?ec=/?sl= OK; build+vet clean.

issues.display_title: Issue #329: A0 — Affiliate: Migration SQL (affiliate table)
issues.main_description_html:
RESULT

✅ Implementation Complete — Ready for Unit Testing

Base Route :

GET /places/detail/bookmarks

CREATE TABLE public.affiliate_categories (
	id INT8 NOT NULL,
	name STRING NOT NULL,
	is_active BOOL NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
	"position" INT8 NOT NULL DEFAULT 0:::INT8,
	created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now():::TIMESTAMPTZ,
	updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now():::TIMESTAMPTZ,
	CONSTRAINT affiliate_categories_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id ASC)
);


CREATE TABLE public.affiliate (
	id UUID NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
	user_id UUID NOT NULL,
	category_id INT8 NOT NULL,
	title STRING NOT NULL,
	url STRING NOT NULL,
	description STRING NULL,
	cta_text STRING NULL,
	created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now():::TIMESTAMPTZ,
	updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now():::TIMESTAMPTZ,
	CONSTRAINT affiliate_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id ASC),
	CONSTRAINT affiliate_user_fk FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES public.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
	CONSTRAINT affiliate_category_fk FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES public.affiliate_categories(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE,
	INDEX idx_affiliate_user (user_id ASC)
);

Source: docs/brainstorming/01-affiliate.md → Task A0 Feature: Affiliate Management (backend, simplified scope — user-owned only)

Task A0 — Migration SQL (no DB execution)

File: docs/plan/migrations/001_affiliate.sql (create)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.affiliate (
    id          UUID        NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    user_id     UUID        NOT NULL,
    category    STRING      NOT NULL,
    title       STRING      NOT NULL,
    url         STRING      NOT NULL,
    description STRING      NULL,
    cta_text    STRING      NULL,
    created_at  TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at  TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    CONSTRAINT affiliate_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id ASC),
    CONSTRAINT affiliate_user_fk
        FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES public.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT affiliate_category_chk
        CHECK (category IN ('Ticket','Stay','Shop')),
    INDEX idx_affiliate_user (user_id ASC)
);

Acceptance

  • File exists; valid CockroachDB SQL; not executed (a human applies it).
  • No slug, no position, no owner_type, no affiliate_categories table.
  • ON DELETE CASCADE on user_id (deleting a user removes their affiliates — no cleanup cron needed).

RESULT

✅ Implementation Complete — Ready for Unit Testing

Base Route :

POST /affiliate

Payload - required :

  • title (max=255)
  • category_id (min=1,max=3)
  • url (max=2048)
  • description (max=2000)
  • cta_text (max=80)
  • ec (PWA should use ec=true)

Example :

{
    "title": "Buy a Ticket",
    "category_id": 1,
    "url": "https://travel.com/tickets/123",
    "description": "Get discount 10% with ref PROMO10",
    "cta_text": "Buy Now",
    "ec": false
}

Source: docs/brainstorming/01-affiliate.md → Task A1 Depends on: A0 (table must exist in the migration file). Style anchor: src/Api/handlers/Supports/SupportCategory.go

Task A1 — Add handler (AddAffiliate)

File: src/Api/handlers/Affiliate/AffiliateHandlers.go (create — new package Affiliate)

Body:

type affiliateBody struct {
    Title       string `json:"title"       validate:"required,max=255"`
    Category    string `json:"category"    validate:"required,oneof=Ticket Stay Shop"`
    URL         string `json:"url"         validate:"required,url,max=2048"`
    Description string `json:"description" validate:"max=2000"`
    CtaText     string `json:"cta_text"    validate:"max=80"`
}

Flow:

  1. ValidateInput → on fail return c.Status(400).JSON(errors).
  2. Identity + role gate: role := c.Locals("role").(string), userId := c.Locals("userId").(string); if role != "user" → 401 Unauthorized.
  3. URL scheme gate (validator url accepts ftp:/mailto:): reject unless prefix http:// or https:// → 400.
  4. html.EscapeString on title/description/cta_text. Leave URL/Category unescaped.
  5. Insert (DB generates UUID): INSERT INTO affiliate (user_id, category, title, url, description, cta_text) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?) RETURNING id.
  6. Success: fiber.Map{"statusCode":200,"data":fiber.Map{"valid":true,"messages":"Affiliate created","id":affiliateId}}.

Acceptance

  • go build ./... + go vet ./... clean.
  • Valid body inserts a row scoped to userId.
  • Bad/empty category → 400 (oneof); non-http(s) URL → 400; missing required field → 400; non-user role → 401.
  • All input parameterized; free text escaped.

RESULT

✅ Implementation Complete — Ready for Unit Testing

Base Route :

PUT /affiliate

Payload - required :

  • id
  • title (max=255)
  • category_id (min=1,max=3)
  • url (max=2048)
  • description (max=2000)
  • cta_text (max=80)
  • ec (PWA should use ec=true)

Example :

{
    "id": "68e57ca9-e0c8-4073-a66c-c614be46db9d",
    "title": "Buy a Ticket Bro",
    "category_id": 2,
    "url": "https://traveling.com/tickets/123",
    "description": "Get discount 10% with ref PROMO10101",
    "cta_text": "Buy Right Now",
    "ec": false
}

Source: docs/brainstorming/01-affiliate.md → Task A2 Depends on: A1 (same package/file). Method: PUT /affiliate (id in body)

Task A2 — Edit handler (UpdateAffiliate)

File: src/Api/handlers/Affiliate/AffiliateHandlers.go

Body: same fields as affiliateBody plus ID string json:"id" validate:"required"``. Full-form update.

Flow:

  1. ValidateInput; role gate (role == "user"); URL scheme gate (as A1).
  2. Ownership proof (IDOR-critical): 
    var existing string
Config.DB.Table("affiliate").Select("id").
    Where("id = ? AND user_id = ?", requestBody.ID, userId).Scan(&existing)
if existing == "" { return Functions.ErrorResponse(c, 404, fiber.ErrNotFound.Message, "Affiliate not found") }
  3. Escape title/description/cta_text.
  4. Update (double-scope WHERE, set updated_at): UPDATE affiliate SET category=?, title=?, url=?, description=?, cta_text=?, updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=? AND user_id=?.
  5. Success fiber.Map{... "messages":"Affiliate updated","id":requestBody.ID}.

Acceptance

  • Owner can edit own item.
  • Editing a non-existent or another user's id → 404, no mutation (no existence leak).
  • Bad category/URL → 400; non-user → 401.
  • go build/go vet clean.

RESULT

✅ Implementation Complete — Ready for Unit Testing

Base Route :

DELETE /affiliate/:sid

Example :

DELETE /affiliate/e7d757d0-afea-4817-97bc-e796cfe713a0

Source: docs/brainstorming/01-affiliate.md → Task A3 Depends on: A1 (same package/file). Method: DELETE /affiliate/:sid (sid = UUID id)

Task A3 — Delete handler (DeleteAffiliate)

File: src/Api/handlers/Affiliate/AffiliateHandlers.go

Flow:

  1. Role gate (role == "user"); affiliateId := c.Params("sid"); reject empty sid → 400.
  2. Ownership proof: SELECT id FROM affiliate WHERE id=? AND user_id=? → "" ⇒ 404.
  3. Delete: DELETE FROM affiliate WHERE id=? AND user_id=?.
  4. Success fiber.Map{... "messages":"Affiliate deleted"}.

Acceptance

  • Owner deletes own item.
  • Deleting a non-existent / other-user id → 404 and no row removed.
  • Non-user → 401.
  • go build/go vet clean.

RESULT

✅ Implementation Complete — Ready for Unit Testing

Source: docs/brainstorming/01-affiliate.md → Task A4 Depends on: A1–A3 (handlers must exist).

Task A4 — Routes + build/vet

File: src/Api/ApiRoutes.go

  • Add import: "panorra-api-new/src/Api/handlers/Affiliate"
  • Add a route group (e.g. after the Bookmark block): 
    // * AFFILIATE ROUTES DEFAULT VERSION * //
AffiliateGroup := http.Group("affiliate")
AffiliateGroup.Post("/", Affiliate.AddAffiliate)
AffiliateGroup.Put("/", Affiliate.UpdateAffiliate)
AffiliateGroup.Delete("/:sid", Affiliate.DeleteAffiliate)

Acceptance

  • go build ./... + go vet ./... clean.
  • All three routes reachable; auth middleware applies (NOT added to any IgnoreAuthPath).
  • Existing routes unaffected (regression check).

Deferred (NOT in scope — see 01-affiliate.md §A5): real "not-a-bot" URL validation (server-side fetch / reCAPTCHA), list/read endpoint, viewer/public cards, ordering/position, per-item slug, per-user caps, Elastic/Redis indexing.
